organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: AI Risk Management Framework Core
provenance: Official NIST AI Resource Center presentation of the AI RMF 1.0 Core
material_use: Supports lifecycle governance, pre-deployment and regular testing, independent review, production monitoring, model monitoring, override, decommissioning, recovery, and change-management boundaries
material_limitations: Voluntary cross-sectoral framework; AI RMF 1.0 is under revision; not a self-storage rule, certification, compliance conclusion, or prescriptive release design

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile NIST AI 600-1
material_use: Supports context-specific pre-deployment testing and the limitation that testing can be inadequate, inconsistent, or mismatched to deployment conditions
material_limitations: Voluntary cross-sectoral profile; not a guarantee of validity, a self-storage deployment standard, or proof that any model is safe for an operational action

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models NIST SP 800-218A
provenance: Official NIST CSRC publication page for the final July 2024 Community Profile
material_use: Supports applying secure-development and lifecycle practices to AI models, AI systems, and acquired systems
material_limitations: Community profile used with SP 800-218; not a product assessment, self-storage architecture mandate, deployment authorization, or certification

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5.1
provenance: Official NIST derivative PDF of SP 800-53 Revision 5.1 controls
material_use: Supports systematic proposal, justification, testing, review, approval, implementation, record retention, monitoring, and oversight of configuration-controlled changes
material_limitations: General federal security and privacy control catalog; requires organizational tailoring and is not an AI-specific self-storage operating rule or compliance conclusion
